do_not_use_when: Kernel-only work (init/observe/think/judge/forge/seal) — call those verbs directly.
You need a binding verdict — use arif_judge.
arifos_manifest.eureka_insight: Orchestration is the physics of routing. Intent→organ is a decision, not an execution. Bridge is opt-in.

mode_purpose.bridge: Route then invoke organ_tool with arguments on the target organ.
mode_purpose.route: Return routing decision only (organ, confidence, mission). No organ call.

purpose: Dispatch natural-language intent to GEOX / WEALTH / WELL / A-FORGE.
Optionally bridge-call an organ tool after routing decision.
use_when: You know what the user wants but not which organ owns it.
Domain evidence is needed from GEOX, WEALTH, or WELL.

description: Classify intent and route tasks to domain organs (GEOX for Earth science, WEALTH for capital markets, WELL for human vitality, A-FORGE for execution). Requires valid session credentials. Outputs: organ dispatch envelope.

actor_id.description: Your agent identity, e.g. 'kimi-code/FI-008' or 'claude/sonnet'. Recorded in the audit log so this action is attributed to you.

contract_c_kwargs.description: Extra keyword arguments passed through to the organ tool call, as a JSON object.

intent.description:
Natural-language description of what the user wants.
          e.g. "interpret this seismic section", "assess portfolio risk"

mission_id.description:
Explicit human-cockpit mission binding (investigate|interpret|
          decide|build|monitor|remember). When set, skips keyword
          classification and binds the six-mission plan. Preferred
          over free-text when the agent already knows the mission.

mode.description: 'route' (default) — classify intent and recommend the target organ; 'triage' — rank a batch of intents; 'delegate' — prepare an A2A handoff; 'status' — surface organ state; 'kernel' — kernel-level status; 'metabolize' — feed routing outcomes to arifFlow. Routing only recommends — execution is arif_forge after a SEAL verdict.

organ.description:
Optional explicit organ override. If provided, intent matching
          is skipped and this organ is used directly.

organ_tool.description:
The tool name on the target organ to call.
          If absent, returns routing decision only (no bridge call).

session_id.description: Session id returned by arif_init (looks like 'sess-…'). Pass it on every call after init so the action is attributed to your governed session.

session_token.description: Session Continuity Token (SCT) — the credential string arif_init returned alongside session_id. Pass it back on follow-up calls to prove the session is yours; without it the kernel treats you as unauthenticated.
